title: Credentials
hint: No credential content is shown here — the API does not return it. This page answers three questions only: where credentials are stored, which places should have one but do not, and which ones keep failing to sync. Editing and rotation happen on the respective configuration pages.
missingHint: These data sources collect nothing, yet they look normal in the list.
staleTitle: Has a credential but sync is stalled
staleHint: The credential may have expired or been revoked — check the error on the Data sources page.
storedHint: This is the credential attack surface of the deployment. Every additional place is one more thing to rotate and audit.

error.title: Could not load the credential inventory

naHint: These authenticate another way: K8s clusters use an in-cluster ServiceAccount or inherit the bound cloud account; internal Prometheus/Loki usually have no auth. Listed so the inventory is complete — they are not missing anything
